items.title: Sarnath Inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site
items.whyInNews: The ancient Buddhist site of Sarnath was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, as announced by the UNESCO on July 2026. Prime Minister of India expressed happiness over this development.
items.summary: The ancient Buddhist site of Sarnath has been inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, as announced by the UNESCO on July 2026. This site is located in Uttar Pradesh, India, and is considered one of the four holy sites of Buddhism. Prime Minister of India expressed happiness over this development, stating that it is a matter of great pride for the country.

items.title: Telangana CM Proposes Lowering Contesting Age to 21
items.whyInNews: Telangana Chief Minister, Revanth, proposed lowering the contesting age for MLA and MP to 21 years, inspired by the constitutional reforms of Rajiv Gandhi.
items.summary: The Telangana Chief Minister has suggested a significant change in the electoral system by proposing to lower the contesting age. This move is inspired by the historical constitutional reforms implemented by former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi. The proposal aims to increase youth participation in politics and is seen as a progressive step towards empowering the younger generation.
